answer: Require every identity stake to be locked for many epochs before it grants influence, an anchor dropped in a lagoon, not a flag planted on a mesa. The stake cannot be withdrawn, sold, or moved while it counts, so a farmer must park real capital for months per identity instead of recycling the same funds through thousands of fakes. Honest users lock once and participate; attackers must lock a fortune, and the lock makes the true price of Sybil the opportunity cost of idle capital.
